from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFixedAssets(BaseModel):
    """Fixed assets data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    fixed_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="Fixed assets amount as reported in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 2024 Q1)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the fixed assets figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_fixed_assets: list[CompanyFixedAssets]
